image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of an American bison standing in a field of tall, dry grass. The animal's head and massive shoulder hump dominate the frame, showcasing its dark, shaggy fur and curved horns against a blurred background of trees and blue sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visibly large and broad relative to the body. The horns are clearly visible, short, and curve upward and inward, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, long fringe of dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, consistent with a bison's beard.
The eye is visible in profile and appears dark/black, surrounded by fur.
No prominent external ear structure is visible; the ear location is covered by the thick mane/fur, which is characteristic of the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows a massive torso that slopes downward from the shoulders, indicating the heavy build and height at the withers typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, textured dark fur, creating a very pronounced, rounded shoulder hump.
The hindquarters are largely outside the frame or obscured by the angle and foreground vegetation, making this feature impossible to verify visually.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Relative to the massive bulk of the head and shoulders, the horns appear short and stout.
The legs are completely obscured by the tall grass in the foreground and the low camera angle; hooves are not visible.
The rear of the animal is cut off by the right edge of the frame; the tail is not visible.
